WITH overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(GOT) as global_avg_got
    FROM Laboratory
),
patient_avgs AS (
    SELECT 
        l.ID,
        AVG(l.GOT) as avg_got,
        AVG(l.RBC) as avg_rbc,
        AVG(l.GOT) - o.global_avg_got as got_difference
    FROM Laboratory l
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
    WHERE o.global_avg_got IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY l.ID, o.global_avg_got
)
SELECT 
    ID,
    avg_got,
    avg_rbc,
    got_difference
FROM patient_avgs
ORDER BY CASE WHEN got_difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, got_difference DESC
LIMIT 10
